new_libraries.name: WiFiClientSecureUdp
new_libraries.author: Andre Lorbach
new_libraries.sentence: Secure UDP client library for ESP32 with DTLS support using mbedTLS
new_libraries.paragraph: WiFiClientSecureUdp provides encrypted and authenticated UDP communication for ESP32 devices. It implements DTLS (Datagram Transport Layer Security) and supports multiple authentication methods including root CA certificates, client certificates, and pre-shared keys (PSK). The library inherits from WiFiClient and provides a familiar API for secure datagram transport, making it ideal for IoT applications requiring secure UDP communication.

library.name: Modest-IoT-Nano-Framework
library.author: Angel Velasquez
library.sentence: An event-driven, asynchronous IoT framework for ESP32, approved by Arduino and available in the Arduino Library Manager.
library.paragraph: Built on a robust object-oriented architecture, Modest IoT enforces Inversion of Control (IoC) and strict communication layer separation. It leverages thread-safe background task messaging queues driven natively by hardware timers, enabling you to build sophisticated, modular, and highly responsive IoT devices while focusing on application logic. Install directly from the Arduino IDE Library Manager or via GitHub.
